{{Infobox |eng = Dandelion |source = [[Foraging]] • [[Spring Seeds]] • [[Flower Dance]] |season = Spring |sellprice = 40 |edibility = 10 |xp = *[[Foraging]]: 7 [[Foraging#Experience Points|Foraging XP]] *[[Spring Seeds]]: 7 [[Foraging#Experience Points|Foraging XP]] *[[Flower Dance]]: 0 |color = Yellow }} The '''Dandelion''' is found via [[foraging]] in the [[Spring]], or grown from [[Spring Seeds]]. Up to ten can be purchased from [[Pierre]] at the [[Flower Dance]]. Up to five can also be purchased from [[Caroline]]'s [[Desert Festival#Villager Shops|shop]] at the [[Desert Festival]] for {{Price|10|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s each. It can randomly be found in [[Garbage Can]]s during Spring. Although it is a flower in its description (and in real life), the game classifies it as "Forage" and not "Flower." ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |neutral=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Abigail,Kent,Alex,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Pam,Emily,Marnie,Gus,Sandy |dislike=Sebastian,Caroline,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Sam,Shane,Elliott,Dwarf,Wizard,Willy,Krobus,Leo |like=Linus,Pierre,Penny,Leah,Harvey |hate=George,Jodi }} ==Recipes== ===Cooking=== {{Recipes|header|hide=buff,duration}} {{:Salad|RecipeRow/NoBuffs}} {{Recipes|footer}} ===Crafting=== {|class="wikitable roundedborder" !Image !Name !Description !Ingredients !Recipe Source !Sell Price |- |[[File:Spring Seeds.png|center]] |[[Crafting#Seeds|Wild Seeds (Sp)]] ||{{Description|Spring Seeds}}
